title: Clean up a messy email
drDigitalIntro:
Time to put everything together — this exercise uses every keyboard skill from Unit 2.
• Someone typed this email in a hurry and made several mistakes: words appear twice in a row, sentences start with lowercase letters, and days of the week are not capitalized.
• Open your Drafts folder, then open the draft to start editing it.
• Use the arrow keys to move to the mistakes and Delete to remove the extra words.
• When the email looks correct, click Send — sending it is the whole point.

playgroundTask.goal: Fix the messy draft and send it

seedDraft.subject: Team meeting reminder
seedDraft.body:
hey sarah

i wanted to remind you the team meeting meeting is is on thursday at 3pm in the big conference room

can you bring the the budget report

see you thursday

thanks
mike

steps.say: Click Drafts in the sidebar to see your saved drafts.
Click on the Team meeting reminder draft to open it for editing.
Fix the body: delete the duplicate words (meeting meeting, is is, the the) and fix the capitals. Click outside the text box when you are done.
Click Send to send the fixed email.

drDigitalSuccess: Outstanding — you used the whole keyboard toolkit to clean that up and send a real email!
drDigitalHint: Use the arrow keys to move to each mistake and Delete to remove the duplicate word. After editing, click outside the body text box, then click Send.
